I read all of lines 1–130: the helper `ggE6Row_torusMulAut_toAdd`, the long proof of `ggE6Row_frame_of_model`, and the wrapper `ggTorusWeylFrameW_of_excPlusModelSCr`.

The only repetition inside the file is the three-line ending `apply Φ.injective; apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective; rw [...]`. It appears in `hρrefl`, `hΨsimple` and `hK_le`. In each place the final `rw` differs, so this is routine ext/injectivity unfolding. A shared lemma would save very little and would not meet the rubric's bar.

I also looked at the sibling `GGTBRowCoordFrame.lean` (`ggTorusWeylFrameW_of_coordFrameElt`). It builds a `GGWeylFrame` by a different route, using `exists_weylGenModel`, `choose`, and `ggAutomizer_eq_map_ggTorusInduced`. It does not repeat the Ψ-construction, the closure induction over Coxeter words, or the cardinality-of-fixed-points argument.

A grep of the `StandardType` directory for `ggE6Row_frame_of_model` and `GGWeylFrame p A M` found no other proof of the same shape. The grep was limited, so I may have missed a duplicate elsewhere in the repository. The wrapper is thin, and I do not count it as repetition.
